name: Gap Spear
description: Throw a spear into the gap between a foe's guard and its next move.

name: Hush Bolt
description: Loose a bolt with no flash and no sound, so the target gets no warning.

name: Held Crash
description: Hold a heavy blow motionless at the foe's chest, then release all of it in a heartbeat.

name: Breathless Peal
description: Let a peal fall in a hush so complete that foes stop breathing a moment before it breaks.

name: Instant Verdict
description: Pass judgment in a stroke that shocks the nerves of the foe before the guard can move.

name: Stilled Thunder
description: Still a thunder in mid-roll over a wide ground so that foes freeze under its weight.

name: Quiet Lance
description: Send a lance of lightning that makes no sound until it has gone through the target.

name: Vanishing Bolt
description: Become a bolt of lightning and appear at the mark with the strike already delivered.

name: Breaking Silence
description: School cast in which the thrower holds all sound in a place and then breaks it with a single peal.

name: Poised Lightning
description: School cast in which a bolt is poised on the finger for a long breath and then falls without a sign.

name: Thunderless Flash
description: School cast in which the thrower streaks in a silent flash and strikes before the thunder arrives.

name: Ruinous Instant
description: Drop a silent ruin on a host at the destructive ceiling of the user's tier in a single instant.

name: Unfelt Strike
description: Strikes the target in the gap before perception, so it is struck before any sense or reflex can register the blow, a consequence event.

name: Primal Bolt
description: Cast a bolt in the oldest form of lightning, a bare white line from cloud to ground.

name: Elder Spear
description: Throw an elder spear of charge that has the weight of a thousand storms behind it.

name: Original Fork
description: Split an original fork of lightning that finds the weak point of any guard.

name: Ancient Peal
description: Roll an ancient peal across a wide ground that makes the stones tremble.

name: Primeval Lance
description: Hurl a lance of primeval lightning through guard, plate and every body in its line.

name: Elder Crash
description: Bring an elder fist down on the foe with the weight of the first thunder.

name: Ancestral Peal
description: Sound a peal handed down from the first thunder that breaks the nerve of all who hear it.

name: Foundational Bolt
description: Cast the bolt on which all other bolts are modelled, cutting through every guard into the nerves.

name: Inaugural Bolt
description: School cast in which the thrower opens a fight with the first bolt, bright as the world's first.

name: Origin Thunder
description: School cast in which the thrower calls up the thunder of origins to roll over the whole ground.

name: Primordial Roar
description: School cast in which the thrower roars with the first voice of thunder and breaks all focus around.

name: Ancient Cataclysm
description: Call the ancient thunder down on a host at the destructive ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Genesis Ruin
description: Loose a ruin as old as thunder itself through a whole line of foes, to the ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Uncaused Bolt
description: A bolt that strikes with no cause in the present, as though it had always fallen; no guard was ever raised; a consequence event.

name: Thunder Hush
description: Stills every charge and thunder in a place for one breath, so that nothing there can be struck or can strike; a consequence event.
